quote: The New Mersenne Conjecture, published by Bateman, Selfridge, and Wagstaff Jr. in 1989, introduced what became known as Wagstaff primes in relation to a conjecture about primes of the form (2^p+1)/3
posed_by: Samuel S. Wagstaff Jr. (with Bateman and Selfridge)
note: The Wikipedia article on Wagstaff primes does not explicitly state when the infinitude conjecture was posed. The term 'Wagstaff primes' and the associated questions appear to originate from the 1989 paper 'The New Mersenne Conjecture' by Bateman, Selfridge, and Wagstaff Jr., published in The American Mathematical Monthly. The infinitude question itself may have been implicit in or emerged from this foundational work, though no earlier explicit statement of the conjecture has been located.
